verdict.rationale: Cooley GO offers interactive document generators (not just static templates) for incorporation packages, YC SAFEs, Series Seed financing docs, and NDAs, where founders answer prompts to generate customized, real legal documents — corroborated by independent community mention (HN) praising both templates and generators. Missing for 10: no hands-on walkthrough of the interactive assembly UI itself, and no detail on document completion/e-signature flow to confirm full self-serve online completion.
